title: Call on Hanuman
line: For strength, steadiness and courage in a hard task.
intro: Hanuman is devotion made strong: swift as the mind, master of himself, and utterly loyal. People turn to him before a challenge, in fear, or when strength is needed for the sake of someone else.
offering: A lamp, sindoor, or a promise kept.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Sit comfortably, with your back upright and soft. Follow the circle: in as it grows, out as it settles. Never strain.

steps.title: Light the lamp
steps.text: Light a real diya if you have one, or this one. Let the flame be the centre of your attention for a moment.

steps.title: Take refuge in him
steps.text: This verse describes him: swift as the mind and the wind, master of the senses, wisest of the wise.

steps.title: His name
steps.text: Repeat AUM Sri Hanumate Namaha with steady attention.

steps.title: What his remembrance gives
steps.text: Read this once: by remembering him, one seeks strength, courage, fearlessness, health and clear speech.

steps.title: Your task
steps.prompt: What is the hard thing in front of me, and what would steady strength look like in it?

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Read the closing prayer once, slowly. Then sit for one more breath before you return to your day.

after: Tuesdays and Saturdays are traditionally his.
